sections.shortTitle: N -W F P Sports Foundation Act 2003
sections.description:
Short title, extent and commencement

ACT XI OF 2003
ACT XI OF 2003
NORTH-WEST
FRONTIER PROVINCE SPORTS
FOUNDATION ACT,
2003.
An Act to provide
for the Establishment of the Sports Foundation in the
North-West
Frontier Province.
[Gazette of
N.-W.F.P., Extraordinary
25th
November, 2003]
No.PA/N.-W.F.P./Legis:1/2003/27654,
dated 25-9-2003.---The North-West Frontier Province Sports Foundation Bill,
2003 having been passed by the Provincial Assembly of North-West Frontier
Province on the 9th September, 2003 and assented to by the Governor of the
North West Frontier Province on 18th September, 2003 is hereby published as an
Act of the Provincial Legislature of the North-West Frontier Province.
It is hereby enacted as
follows:--
1. Short title, extent and
commencement.---(1) This Act may be called the North-West Frontier Province
Sports Foundation Act, 2003.
(2) It extends to the whole of
the North-West Frontier, Province.
(3) It shall come into force at
once.

3. Establishment of the
Foundation.---( 1) There shall be a Sports Foundation in the North-West
Frontier Province to be known as the North-West Frontier Province Sports
Foundation.
(2) The Foundation shall be a
body corporate, having perpetual succession and a common seal, with powers
subject to this Act, to acquire and hold property, both movable and immovable,
and may, by the said name, sue and be sued.

[Gazette of

25th
November, 2003]
No.PA/N.-W.F.P./Legis:1/2003/27654,
dated 25-9-2003.---The North-West Frontier Province Sports Foundation Bill,
2003 having been passed by the Provincial Assembly of North-West Frontier
Province on the 9th September, 2003 and assented to by the Governor of the
North West Frontier Province on 18th September, 2003 is hereby published as an
Act of the Provincial Legislature of the North-West Frontier Province.
It is hereby enacted as
follows:--
4. Purposes of the Foundation.
----(1) The purposes of the Foundation shall be as under:---
(a) providing help/stipend to
outstanding sportsmen of yesteryears who have fallen on bad times;
(b) providing help/stipend to the
children of deceased outstanding sportsmen;
(c) sports scholarships to
outstanding sportsmen of schools/colleges and utter-provincial youth
competitions;
(d) sports scholarships/one time
grant to players selected to represent Pakistan Seniors as well as Juniors
teams and any other sportsmen/sportswomen who will show excellent performance
in the provincial/national and international level competitions;
(e) impart coaching and training
to talented players;
(f) purchase of sports
equipments; and
(g) holding of local sports
competitions in different games at various levels.

No.PA/N.-W.F.P./Legis:1/2003/27654,
dated 25-9-2003.---The North-West Frontier Province Sports Foundation Bill,
2003 having been passed by the Provincial Assembly of North-West Frontier
Province on the 9th September, 2003 and assented to by the Governor of the
North West Frontier Province on 18th September, 2003 is hereby published as an
Act of the Provincial Legislature of the North-West Frontier Province.
It is hereby enacted as
follows:--
7. Fund.---(1) There shall
be a Fund of the Foundation to be known as the North-West Frontier Province
Sport's Foundation Fund.
(2) Sources of the Foundation
shall be as under:
(a) Funds/grants-in-aid to be
received from Government;
(b) Funds/donations/grant-in-aid
from any other sources;
(c) through generation of other
resources with the approval of Government.
(3) The Fund shall be kept in a
Bank account or in any of the profitable Government sponsored schemes or in
other profitable use, with the approval of the Administrative Authority.
(4) The profit accrued on and
from the Fund shall be utilized for the purposes of the Foundation.
(5) The accounts of the Fund
shall be audited by a Charactered Accountant duly authorized by the
Administrative Committee, once in a year, and the audited statement of account
shall be placed before the Administrative Committee for approval.
